beats.vo: If you're doing work a system could handle, that's a problem worth fixing.
Manual processes don't feel like a crisis — they just quietly eat your best hours.
Before you automate anything, you need a simple three-bucket audit.
Rule-based, low-stakes, repeatable — that's what gets automated first.
Judgment, relationships, and real decisions stay with a human — always.
